description: The chart illustrates Shapley values for a set of morphosyntactic feature categories, shown as grouped bars for three models (mBERT, XLM-R, and chLSTM). The horizontal axis contains the categories labeled (left to right) L₄⁺, L₃, L₂, L₁, T, R₁, R₂, R₃, and R₄⁺, and the vertical axis is labeled “Shapley value” on a linear scale with labeled ticks at approximately 0, 20, 40, 60, and 80. Each category has three adjacent bars: mBERT in light blue, XLM-R in darker blue, and chLSTM in light green, as indicated by the legend in the upper right. Approximate bar heights are: for L₄⁺, mBERT ≈6, XLM-R ≈6, chLSTM ≈0; for L₃, mBERT ≈1, XLM-R ≈2, chLSTM ≈0; for L₂, mBERT ≈4, XLM-R ≈6, chLSTM ≈1; for L₁, mBERT ≈14, XLM-R ≈15, chLSTM ≈14; for T, mBERT ≈59, XLM-R ≈55, chLSTM ≈79; for R₁, mBERT ≈10, XLM-R ≈11, chLSTM ≈9; for R₂, mBERT ≈2, XLM-R ≈3, chLSTM slightly below 0 (about −1); for R₃, mBERT is near 0, XLM-R ≈1, chLSTM slightly below 0 (about −1); and for R₄⁺, mBERT ≈5, XLM-R ≈6, chLSTM slightly below 0 (about −1). The bars are grouped by category rather than stacked, the categories appear in the fixed L-to-T-to-R order shown on the axis (not visibly sorted by magnitude), and there are no special visual emphases such as annotations or highlighted bars beyond the color coding and legend.
